scope: Exploratory retrospective selection among previously frozen complete-source deletions, extending lean_source_utility_channel_pilot_v1 after inspecting prior source and random outcomes. Choose the lowest label-free group score with lowest-index tie-breaking; compare identical 1024-key removals, mean of all five arms as a descriptive random expectation, per-sequence present Dice and empty-frame false alarms. All masks and predictions pre-exist scoring; no video propagation, GT-derived selection, redetection or new confidence gate. Seq9/10 have been previously inspected and are not independent confirmation. The evaluation is too small to support generalization, online utility or absence claims.
